 A FIELD GUIDE TO EXPLORING

Take the scenic route.

Walk
WASD or the up and down arrows. Hold Shift for a quicker pace.
Look
Drag the landscape, use left and right arrows, or enable mouse look. Escape releases the pointer.
Read
Approach a landmark and press E. The index opens every chapter directly.
Find your way
Press M or open the field map, choose a destination, then Walk here. WASD or Escape stops the guide. On touch screens, use the direction buttons and drag the scene to look. Return to start at any time. The complete field guide is always available.
